info.name: BIZZKICKR
info.summary: Digital business cards and confirmed connections that become contacts
info.description:
Hand over your business card at a trade show or in a meeting, and keep every confirmed connection in your Nextcloud contacts.
- **Your card from your profile:** BIZZKICKR creates your digital business card from your Nextcloud profile. Show its QR code or send it by email. - **Send your card from Contacts:** "Send my BIZZKICKR card" in the contacts menu of anyone with an email address. - **Confirmed connections only:** whoever scans your card asks to connect; you accept or decline in Nextcloud. - **Connections become contacts:** each confirmed connection appears in your address book. Later changes to their card follow, unless you changed that field yourself.
Free. An administrator connects this Nextcloud to GCN-ALLIANCE once (free sign-up, or the existing link of the Phone System app); each user then registers with their own email address and confirms it. BIZZKICKR is provided by COMWIZE and booked through GCN-ALLIANCE. Guides and the service provider's contact: https://gcn-alliance.com/support/nextcloud/
More about the [digital business card with QR code](https://gcn-alliance.com/blog/digital-business-card-qr-code/).
info.author: GCN Alliance
